description: Incomplete bugs: reads the status, posts the drafted reminder (for an In Progress bug with one extra sentence saying why it goes back to Open); then an Open bug gets the need_refinement label, an In Progress bug is moved back to Open (through the Jira transition that leads there) and gets the label, any other status is left alone. Complete bugs: adds the ready_for_development label. Labels go into the label field, never a comment (JIRA_BASE_URL + JIRA_PAT from the environment); writes audit-report.md. dryRun=yes changes nothing (it may still read status and transitions). A failed comment, transition or label update makes the verdict blocking so the run pauses instead of losing work. No model call.

params.label: Dry run
params.description: yes = change nothing in Jira, only write the report

params.label: Label field id
params.description: Jira field that receives ready_for_development: labels (the standard Labels field) or a custom labels field id such as customfield_12345.
